name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Russia Bill Broadens Sanctions but Could Fuel Fears Over the Dollar
changes.summary: The Trump administration has recently sought to scale back sanctions as adversaries develop workarounds that some believe could erode the U.S. dollar’s supremacy.

changes.title: A Putin critic is convicted on charges that will keep him from campaigning for Russia's parliament
changes.summary: The verdict underlined the determination by authorities to stamp out any remaining sign of dissent ahead of September's vote as the fuel crisis caused by Ukrainian strikes on oil facilities across Russia threatened to erode public support for the Kremlin.

changes.title: Ukraine fights under an interim defense chief after Zelenskyy's contested government shake-up
changes.summary: Ukraine fought Russia's more than 4-year-old invasion under an interim defense minister Friday, a day after a government reshuffle exposed a deep split between the military's old guard and young innovators over how to fight the war.

changes.title: Pro-Kremlin blogger who turned on Putin is arrested as Russia steps up crackdown
changes.summary: A former loyalist blogger turned fierce critic of Russian President Vladimir Putin has been detained and accused of spreading false information about the armed forces, state media reported Friday.

changes.title: Ukrainian's Zelenskyy faces major backlash for ousting defense chief Mykhailo Fedorov amid progress vs. Russia
changes.summary: Ukrainians are demonstrating in Kyiv and senior figures announcing their resignations over President Volodymyr Zelenksyy's move to oust his popular defense chief.

changes.title: Zelenskyy fires Ukraine's tech-savvy defense minister in government reshuffle
changes.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has fired the country's popular defense minister, who pushed for innovation in the battlefield through the use of drones and turned the tables on Russia. (Image credit: ROMAN PILIPEY).

changes.title: Dismissal of Ukraine's popular defense minister draws intense criticism
changes.summary: As Ukraine signs drone deals and awaits licenses for Patriot missiles, the country's popular, tech-savvy defense minister, who helped Ukraine turn the tables on Russia through drone warfare, is fired.

changes.title: Ukraine Pounds Russian Ships in Its Campaign to Cut Off Crimea
changes.summary: After striking roads and railways, Kyiv is now focusing on sea routes as it tries to disrupt fuel supplies and pressure Russia to end the war.

changes.title: Lindsey Graham’s Death Leaves Fate of Russia Sanctions Bill Uncertain
changes.summary: Supporters in both parties hope the measure to penalize Russia, championed by Senator Lindsey Graham, will gain momentum in his honor.
